settings.player.preset_hint: Applied when playback starts. Heavier presets need a capable GPU.
settings.player.skip_hint: ani.zip and AniSkip markers when available.
settings.player.engine_hint: How video plays. A change applies the next time you start an episode.
settings.player.mode.embedded_hint: mpv inside this window with Tatakai's controls. Works on Linux and Windows.
settings.player.mode.embedded_enhanced_h: The same embedded player with the mpv-anime-build profiles, shaders and scripts.
settings.player.mode.external_hint: Your own mpv in its own window, with your config and controls. Tatakai shows what is playing.
settings.player.enhanced_ui.ours_hint: Tatakai's controls and shortcuts; uosc stays off.
settings.player.enhanced_ui.uosc_hint: The build's uosc interface and key bindings; Tatakai's controls hide.
settings.player.anime_hint: Verified and unpacked into the data folder once. Starting an episode also prepares it if needed.
settings.player.anime.missing_hint: This installation does not include mpv-anime-build, so the enhanced mode is unavailable.
settings.player.mpv_path_hint: The mpv that external mode starts, with your own config and controls.
settings.player.mpv_path_auto: Empty = autodetect (PATH and the usual install folders)
settings.player.mpv.no_version: Found, but it did not start
settings.player.mpv.not_found_custom: There is no file at that path. Fix it or clear the field to autodetect.
settings.player.mpv.install.linux: Install mpv with your package manager (for example sudo pacman -S mpv or sudo apt install mpv) or set its path.
settings.player.mpv.install.windows: Install mpv (mpv.io, scoop or winget) or set the path to mpv.exe.
settings.player.mpv.install.mac: Install mpv (for example brew install mpv) or set its path.
settings.player.preset_hint_embedded: Embedded mode only: the enhanced build brings its own shaders and external mpv uses your config. Applied when playback starts; heavier presets need a capable GPU.
